messages.content: 在一場撲克遊戲中，確定贏家是誰，約翰手中有8♥、10♥、J♥、Q♥、K♥，邁克手中有9♠、J♠、10♠、Q♠、K♠。

function.name: card_games_poker_determine_winner
function.description: Determines the winner in a game of Poker based on the cards in each players' hands. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

hand1.description: The list of cards (as strings) in first player's hand. E.g ['10♠', 'J♠']

hand2.description: The list of cards (as strings) in second player's hand. E.g ['9♥', '10♥']

message.content:
在這兩手牌中：

- 約翰的牌是 **8♥ 10♥ J♥ Q♥ K♥**，全是紅心，形成一副 **同花**（flush），但並不是順子（缺少 9♥）。
- 邁克的牌是 **9♠ 10♠ J♠ Q♠ K♠**，全是黑桃，同樣是一副 **同花**。

兩手牌都是同花，接下來比較各自牌面大小：

| 牌位 | 約翰 | 邁克 |
|------|------|------|
| 高牌 | K    | K    |
| 次高 | Q    | Q    |
| 第三 | J    | J    |
| 第四 | 10   | 10   |
| 最低 | 8    | 9    |

最低牌決定勝負，邁克的 9 大於約翰的 8，因此 **邁克贏得這局**。
message.reasoning: We need to determine winner. John has 8♥,10♥,J♥,Q♥,K♥. That's a straight flush from 8 to K? Actually 8-10-J-Q-K is a straight flush (8-9-10-J-Q-K? Wait missing 9♥). He has 8♥,10♥,J♥,Q♥,K♥. That's not a straight flush because missing 9♥. It's a flush (all hearts) but not straight. He has high card K. Mike has 9♠,J♠,10♠,Q♠,K♠. That's also a flush (spades) but missing 8♠. Also high card K. So both flushes. Compare highest card: both K. Next: Q vs Q. Next: J vs J. Next: 10 vs 10. Next: 8 vs 9. Mike has 9, John has 8. So Mike wins. So answer: Mike wins.
